The 8085 microprocessor is housed in a 40-pin DIP package.  
Not all pins are output pins — some are input, some are bidirectional, and some are power/clock pins.  
Counting only dedicated output pins (like address bus high, control signals such as WR, S0, S1, etc.) yields 27 output pins.  
This is a standard fact in microprocessor architecture.  

Final answer: (A)
